key.latticium.stop: Stop task and suspend automatic activation
text.autoconfig.latticium.title: Latticium settings
text.autoconfig.latticium.option.pauseOn: Stops new submissions; already sent actions still settle. Resume the task explicitly when ready.
text.autoconfig.latticium.option.hud.ena: Visible during gameplay; follows the Hide GUI option and stays hidden over screens.
text.autoconfig.latticium.option.hud.sho: By default the HUD appears only for a task, a pending confirmation, a stop hold, or an activation error.
text.autoconfig.latticium.option.diagnos: Include original diagnostic messages for troubleshooting and copied reports.
Refreshes screen text and diagnostics only; does not change job scanning or action speed.
Caps displayed groups. Total blocked counts still include omitted groups.
latticium.screen.title: Latticium task controls
latticium.screen.profile_tip: Click to cycle loaded profiles. Shift-click to cycle backwards.
latticium.screen.start_tip: Starts the selected profile, replacing the current task. Unavailable while an action is awaiting confirmation.
latticium.screen.cancel_tip: Stops new actions. An already submitted action still needs to settle; this does not undo changes.
latticium.screen.refresh_tip: Queues a bounded rescan. After action-budget exhaustion, starts a new action budget.
latticium.screen.stop_tip: Cancels the task and holds all automatic activation until explicitly restored. Sent actions still settle.
latticium.screen.load_hint: Load a profile with /latticium profile load <file>. Existing fill/replace/clear commands also create profiles.
latticium.state.no_world: Join a world to control tasks
latticium.status.continuous: Continuous mode keeps monitoring after the first scan. Satisfied candidates include positions already at their target.
latticium.status.manual: Manual mode performs one pass. Satisfied candidates include positions already at their target.
latticium.status.confirmation: A submitted interaction is not complete until the server update and expected world state are observed.
latticium.hud.title: Latticium · %s
latticium.diagnostics.limited: Showing %s of %s reason groups; totals include hidden groups.
latticium.diagnostics.no_blocked: No blocked positions have been reported.
latticium.diagnostics.scan_note: Unloaded or unknown data stays unresolved. Scanned sections are not a whole-task completion percentage.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.reach: Move within normal interaction reach of the example position.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.material: Check allowed materials and place the required block item in the hotbar.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.data: Load the relevant chunks and check that the target source is still available.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.budget: Review the profile limits. Refresh scan starts a new action budget after exhaustion.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.policy: Check the profile breaking policy before permitting changes to existing blocks.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.confirmation: Check the actual world state and connection, then request a fresh scan.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.changed: Check intervening world changes or a changed blueprint placement before rescanning.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.unsupported: Check reach, hotbar items and target state. Some placement behaviors cannot be predicted yet.
latticium.diagnostics.hint.other: Inspect the original engine detail and copy a report if the issue persists.
latticium.registry_reload: Registry tags changed. The current task was stopped; start it again to use the new tags.
